# Opp Avenue

> Opp Avenue is a career portal helping professionals discover jobs, read career blogs, and access curated resources across India and remote roles.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse and search latest job openings across roles, domains, and locations.
- [Blogs](/blogs): Career advice, industry insights, and guidance articles.
- [Resources](/resources): Curated career resources organized by category (guides, government reports, templates, etc.).
- [About](/about): About Opp Avenue.
- [Advertise](/advertise): Post a job or promote your brand.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch.
